actual_tool_job.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, lighting, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body with green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the actual observed dark brown/grey hair swept back into a compact low bun, real brow hair, and round clear wire spectacles with faint source glints. Maintain the serious closed mouth and absence of separate moustache or beard. Keep the dark brown outer garment and dark blue/grey scarf wrapped at the neckline with only faint source-visible pale oval spot highlights; do not invent a tie or white shirt. Ensure the rounded chin immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the exact observed garment, scarf, and collar opening and fastening, ensuring coherent front and rear collar overlap with contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its exact original dark grey color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. Keep all solid surfaces opaque, with alpha transparency only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not add any insignia, text, or accessories. Maintain the extremely dark low-key lighting, preserving deep facial and clothing shadows and tiny narrow highlights without globally relighting or brightening the portrait. Keep fine hidden details indistinct and understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: EXTREMELY DARK low-key bareheaded IMAGE-LEFT-facing bust. Preserve original deep facial/clothing shadows and tiny narrow highlights; do NOT globally relight or brighten into a well-lit portrait. Actual dark brown/grey hair swept back into a compact low bun/gathered back, real brow hair, ROUND clear wire spectacles with faint source glints, serious CLOSED mouth and no separate moustache or beard. Dark BROWN outer garment and dark BLUE/GREY SCARF wrapped at neckline with only faint source-visible pale oval spot highlights; do not invent a tie or white shirt. Mascot yellow/green eyes remain appropriately shadowed under the same low light. Keep DARK grey photographic backing opaque, tilted frame and contrasting pale cream note unchanged in light/overlap. Fine hidden details remain indistinct.
Preserve exact source head angle and expression. Whole yellow area above raised/broadened neckline is one compact near-round head, with clearly rounded chin immediately contacting the very short broad collar transition, no additional separate neck shaft or pointed V. Image1 is the exact original small card; Image2 identity only. Fine markings indistinct in Image1 must remain understated, not invented as a readable symbol.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
